line.en: Words and marks bent in glass tube on a dark brick wall at night, stuttering alight letter by letter and humming, switched off between scenes.
line.zh-CN: 夜里暗色砖墙上用玻璃灯管弯成的字和标志，逐字闪烁着亮起、轻轻嗡鸣，换场时整面墙关灯。

for.en: Openings and stings, titles and short facts told one sign at a time: nightlife, cities, music, food and late-night shows, and any short film that wants a warm after-dark voice.
for.zh-CN: 片头与标识、标题和一条一条的短事实：夜生活、城市、音乐、餐饮与深夜节目，以及任何想要温暖夜色气质的短片。

not.en: Long explanations, diagrams, maps or tables: a sign holds a few words. Daylight, sober or sombre subjects.
not.zh-CN: 长篇解释、示意图、地图或表格：一块招牌只放得下几个字。白天感、严肃或沉重的题材。
